steps.text: 7:59 P.M. \ Cloudy
Lungmen Aqueduct, Pier

steps.name: Stranger
steps.text: Now don't go jumping onto any more boats! It's dangerous!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sorry, it's just, we were...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: By the way, you didn't happen to see a Sankta lady around here, did you?

steps.name: Stranger
steps.text: I didn't see anything. And I don't have time for this. These sweets are for the after party and are you gonna pay me if they turn up late... Oh?

steps.name: Stranger
steps.text: A S- Sankta...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Ah! Mostim——

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Mostima? You know Mostima?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sorry. I mistook you for someone else.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: (This lady sure looks familiar.)

steps.name: Stranger
steps.text: Ahem. Anyway, I'll let you off this time. But don't go doing anything that dangerous ever again.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: S- sorry. I didn't mean to trouble you.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hm... Forte kid... there was something about a Forte kid... what was it...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Aaah! What are you doing?!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You had some candy on your horn.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh, really? I should probably give it back to...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: And looking at your horns reminded me of something! They're just like the Mountain Dash Logistics logo!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You're the little prince of MDL, aren't you?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Little... prince...?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Sora, ma'am, is this really the way back to Texas and the others?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Relax, I know what Texas is thinking at all times. I can see right into her head.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Oh.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...her voice has such a familiar quality to it, but I can't put my finger on it.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: 'Ma'am,' huh? Hehe, I never thought the day would come when young Messengers would be calling me that~ So what's your impression of everybody?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Impression?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: They're very... um... spirited people.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ahahaha... I can guess what they must've put you through...

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Oh, sorry!

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Watch where you're going! Ptoo!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: That was clearly your fault——

steps.name: Child
steps.text: Who asked you? Mind your own business!

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: You little brat!

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Don't worry about it. Let him go.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: But he just swiped your wallet——

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hehe, he sure did. But that wallet just had some pumpkin candies inside. See? This is the real one~

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You familiar with the old expression 'trick or treat'?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: He was here just to make trouble, and today's not even... why would you have something like that?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: You may not be able to tell at first glance, but Lungmen's been through a lot lately.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Sauin candles aren't bright enough to light up all the dark corners of this city, and those kids don't exactly have it easy.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: But hey, it's just something I came up with. Not bad, huh?

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: What if he grabbed my wallet instead...?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Should be right up ahead.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Isn't this... the park from before? Did we just make a big circle?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: See? Here they are.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Mmmh! Mmff mff!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Listen, if you don't talk, I'm gonna have to light this fuse.

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Yer lips better start flappin', kiddo. These fireworks'll blow ya sky high.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...You forgot to take the tape off his mouth.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, right. Haha.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: You crazy broads! Do you have any idea who we are?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ...the Siracusan Mafia.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Urk, T- Texas...? Don't think we're scared of you!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh we know you're not scared. Why else would you blow up all the boss's collectibles. A bomb in a candy box, though? That's kids' stuff.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: ...what are you talking about?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh?

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: I don't know nothin' about no candy box. But if our capo did up a bomb, you'd all be in pieces—— Mmmf! Mmmh!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: This guy sure is full of himself. Let's blast him.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Patience, Exusiai. Let him talk.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: *Gasp*——Hah. Ain't you the least bit curious why Lungmen's lettin' us get away with all this?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Not really. As long as we go down to the station once a month to pay our property damage fines, they pretty much let us do whatever too.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Gah...

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: C'mon, Exu, let the feller say his piece.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Just look at you broads...!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: We got the big man's OK to do whatever we want to Penguin Logistics, right from the real power in Lungmen. You know what that means, don't you?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: We're a legitimate logistics business? And a pretty good one at that?

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Then why do we always end up... You know what? Forget it.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Who's 'the big man' you're talking about?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: It sounds really pretentious. Super gross.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Don't play dumb! The Rat King's——

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hey! Texas! And the rest!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Oh, Sora! What's up~

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: How about that. She wrangled Bison too.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hehe, I ran into this lost little calf on my way over, I thought I'd bring him along.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Um... what are you doing? And where's Mr. Emperor?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: The boss went somewhere to do something.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: You didn't run into anyone else, Sora?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Hm? I don't... think... so.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh? Do I have something on my face?

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: N- no. Anyway, Bison filled me in on the whole story. Where do we go from here?

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: First we get some more answers from our little buddy, then we formulate an appropriate... response.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Wait, Exusiai, do you mean...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: I actually ran into Mostima back there. But then I lost her.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: Erm, I mean, after we shook the mobsters, she——

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: ...don't worry about her. That's just how she is. Vanishing years at a time.

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: ...years?

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Tell ya the truth, I barely seen heads or tails of her since they hired me.

steps.name: Sora
steps.text: Ahaha, let's not get Exusiai too riled up...

steps.name: Bison
steps.text: This is all very... unorthodox.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: She's a special kind of Messenger.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: Contractually, she works for the boss, but more often Laterano has her——

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: ——Exusiai, watch your match.

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: Huh? Oops.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: MMMMH! MMF——!!

steps.name: Croissant
steps.text: Darn it, looks like we're outta time. But that's the way the cookie crumbles.

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: MMMMMNG!!!!!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Heyo, that sounded like Fronzo! And it didn't sound good!

steps.name: Mafioso
steps.text: Let's get over there!

steps.name: Exusiai
steps.text: So they really can send a person flying. These fireworks are something else.

steps.name: Texas
steps.text: We've got company. Six and three o'clock.
